moments.title: UK Heatwave Warning
moments.blurb: A widespread heatwave is forecast for England and Wales next week, with temperatures potentially reaching 36°C in some areas by Thursday, August 13th.

angles.name: Heatwave build-up
angles.copy: Sun's out, shades on! Temperatures are climbing this weekend, setting us up for a widespread heatwave across England and Wales next week. Stay cool, Nation!

angles.name: Peak heat forecast
angles.copy: Grab your ice lollies! Forecasters say temperatures could hit 36°C by Thursday in parts of the South East. How are you beating the heat?

angles.name: North/South split
angles.copy: While England and Wales bake in the sunshine, our friends in Scotland and Northern Ireland can expect some much-needed rain next week. Quite the weather split across the UK!

moments.title: Premier League Pre-Season Continues
moments.blurb: Premier League clubs are in full swing with their pre-season fixtures this week, gearing up for the 2026/27 season kick-off on August 21st.

angles.name: Pre-season action
angles.copy: Pre-season friendlies are heating up across the UK! Who are you most excited to see in action before the Premier League proper kicks off?

angles.name: Countdown to kick-off
angles.copy: Not long now until the Premier League returns! Clubs are putting in the work this week with final pre-season matches. Who's looking sharp?

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The 2026 Community Shield match between Arsenal and Manchester City will be held at Principality Stadium in Cardiff, Wales, on Sunday, August 16th, due to concerts at Wembley.

angles.name: Cardiff hosts Community Shield
angles.copy: Big football coming to Wales! Cardiff's Principality Stadium hosts the Community Shield this year, as Arsenal take on Man City on August 16th. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Wembley workaround
angles.copy: Wembley's busy, so the Community Shield is heading to Cardiff this year! Get ready for Arsenal vs Man City at Principality Stadium next Sunday. A great day out for Welsh football fans!

moments.title: London Bids for World Athletics 2029
moments.blurb: London officially submitted its final bid to host the 2029 World Athletics Championships on August 6th, with the host city decision expected in September.

angles.name: London's big bid
angles.copy: London wants to host the 2029 World Athletics Championships! The final bid was submitted yesterday – fingers crossed we hear good news in September!

angles.name: Athletics coming home?
angles.copy: Could the World Athletics Championships be returning to London in 2029? The bid is in, aiming to bring world-class sport back to the capital.

moments.title: Andrew Flintoff Steps Down
moments.blurb: Cricket legend Andrew Flintoff, 48, has stepped down as England Lions head coach due to other commitments, including a role in Australia's Big Bash League.

angles.name: Freddie leaves Lions
angles.copy: Freddie Flintoff is stepping down as England Lions head coach! He's off to the Big Bash League in Australia and has other TV work lined up. Good luck, Freddie!

angles.name: New chapter for Flintoff
angles.copy: A new chapter for Andrew 'Freddie' Flintoff as he exits his England Lions role. What a career he's had so far, and plenty more to come!

moments.title: Football Transfer Buzz
moments.blurb: Barcelona's opening bid for Manchester City midfielder Rodri was rejected, while City is reportedly eyeing Chelsea's Enzo Fernandez, 25, as a potential replacement.

angles.name: Transfer saga heats up
angles.copy: Transfer window drama! Barcelona's move for Man City's Rodri hit a snag, and now City are looking at Chelsea's Enzo Fernandez. Who do you think will move where?

angles.name: Premier League merry-go-round
angles.copy: Could we see a big Premier League midfield reshuffle? Rodri to Barcelona, Fernandez to Man City... it's all happening!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival Approaches
moments.blurb: Reading & Leeds Festival is set for August 27th-30th, 2026, over the Bank Holiday weekend, with Charli XCX among the first wave of announced artists.

angles.name: Bank Holiday festival fun
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds Festival is just around the corner! Get ready for an epic Bank Holiday weekend of music, August 27th-30th. Who's got their tickets?

angles.name: Charli XCX at R&L
angles.copy: Charli XCX is among the first names announced for Reading & Leeds! Are you ready to party at Richfield Avenue or Bramham Park?

moments.title: We Out Here Festival Sold Out
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's We Out Here Festival, celebrating jazz and UK club culture, takes place in Dorset from August 20th-23rd and is already sold out.

angles.name: We Out Here is back
angles.copy: Gilles Peterson's We Out Here Festival is back in Dorset next week, August 20th-23rd! It's sold out, but who's lucky enough to be going?

angles.name: Jazz & Club Culture
angles.copy: Celebrating the best of jazz and UK club culture, We Out Here Festival is a highlight of the summer. Get ready for some incredible sets!

moments.title: Roots Picnic Debuts in London
moments.blurb: The iconic US hip hop festival, Roots Picnic, makes its international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, on August 8th-9th, bringing its blend of music, culture, and community.

angles.name: Roots Picnic comes to London
angles.copy: Huge news for hip hop fans! The legendary Roots Picnic is making its international debut in London this weekend, August 8th-9th, at Crystal Palace Bowl. Who's excited?

angles.name: Hip Hop in Crystal Palace
angles.copy: Crystal Palace Bowl is set to host the first-ever Roots Picnic outside the US this Saturday and Sunday. Expect incredible music and an amazing vibe!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Make Chart History
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' has become the longest-running UK number-one single of all time, with 20 non-consecutive weeks at the top.

angles.name: Chart record broken
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is now the longest-running UK number-one single EVER with 20 weeks at the top! Incredible achievement!

angles.name: Longest number one
angles.copy: Can you believe 'Rein Me In' has been number one for 20 non-consecutive weeks? Sam Fender and Olivia Dean have truly made their mark on the UK charts!

moments.title: Miley Cyrus's New Chart Success
moments.blurb: Miley Cyrus's new track 'Younger You' has debuted at No. 5 on the Official Physical Singles chart and No. 4 on the Official Vinyl Singles chart.

angles.name: Miley's new hit
angles.copy: Miley Cyrus is back in the charts with 'Younger You'! It's already a top 5 hit on the physical singles chart. Are you loving her new track?

angles.name: Vinyl success for Miley
angles.copy: Miley Cyrus hitting big on vinyl with 'Younger You' at No. 4! Proof that physical music is still thriving. What's your favourite Miley track?

moments.title: Bruno Mars Albums Re-enter Charts
moments.blurb: Following his six sold-out shows at Wembley Stadium in July, Bruno Mars's albums and singles are seeing a resurgence on the UK charts, with 'Die With A Smile' (with Lady Gaga) at No. 28.

angles.name: Bruno Mars chart comeback
angles.copy: That Wembley magic! Bruno Mars' albums are back in the charts after his incredible run of shows. 'Die With A Smile' with Lady Gaga is a top 30 hit! What's your favourite Bruno Mars song?

angles.name: Wembley effect for Bruno
angles.copy: The Bruno Mars effect is real! His Wembley gigs have sent his music soaring back up the charts. If you saw him live, tell us your highlight!

moments.title: Buried with Michael Sheen
moments.blurb: A new factual series, 'Buried with Michael Sheen', premieres on BBC Two on Monday, August 17th, at 9pm.

angles.name: Michael Sheen's new show
angles.copy: Tune in! Michael Sheen's new factual series, 'Buried with Michael Sheen', starts Monday, August 17th, at 9pm on BBC Two. What do you think it's about?

angles.name: Must-watch TV
angles.copy: Mark your calendars! Michael Sheen brings us a new series on BBC Two next Monday. Always brilliant, always engaging!

moments.title: PopMaster TV Launch
moments.blurb: The popular radio quiz 'PopMaster' gets its own TV adaptation, 'PopMaster TV', premiering on More4 on Monday, August 17th, at 9pm.

angles.name: PopMaster on TV
angles.copy: It's finally happening! The legendary 'PopMaster' is coming to TV! Catch 'PopMaster TV' on More4 next Monday, August 17th, at 9pm. Get ready to test your music knowledge!

angles.name: Ken Bruce's new venture
angles.copy: From radio to screen! PopMaster is making the jump to TV next week. Who's excited to see the iconic quiz in a new format?
